description: A national document by id, e.g. "AT-NOR-12345". Same fields in every country: documentKind ("act" | "decision"); decisions add court, chamber, caseNumbers, citedNorms; articles {number, title, section, text, inForceFrom, inForceTo} (text: null = no text for that unit). Large documents return an outline first; view "full" with offset returns the text. content: null = the source publishes no machine-readable text (textAvailability says why). A document its source withdrew returns a distinct error (410) and nothing of it is served. attribution must be kept with republished content (Terms). Cost: 1 credit.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter code of a live country, e.g. "at" (lex_national_coverage lists them).

language.description: Not needed: documents are held in the country's own language, and any other value is a 404.

offset.description: Continue after a truncated response (value given in its note).

view.description: auto: the body if it fits maxChars, else an outline. full: body up to maxChars, then offset to continue.

name: lex_get_national_document
title: Fetch a national document
